text: Nora (Design): Quick run: noticed header buttons in the Observability dashboard are truncating at compact density and the toast copy is inconsistent across flows. Screenshot + short vid in thread. Evan (Frontend): Repro: set density=compact -> header action group shows: [Export] as icon+short label but the width clamps and truncates to 'Ex...' causing a tooltip-only affordance. Also toasts: success uses 'Done' in one flow and 'Export completed' in another. Samir (a11y): Truncation is problematic for keyboard users who rely on visible labels. Two options: 1) keep icons+label but allow wrapping to two lines at very small widths, 2) collapse to full-width stacked controls at narrow breakpoints. Also ensure all header buttons have aria-label full text even if visually truncated. Alicia (Product): We like compact density but not at the cost of discoverability. Proposal: token change: header.minLabelWidth = 64px and header.iconLabelWrap = true; in compact mode show label only on focus/hover otherwise hide but keep accessible name. Also standardize toast copy to use short, noun-first phrasing: 'Export started', 'Export complete', 'Export failed'. Evan (Frontend): Implementation plan: 1) add CSS utility `.label-wrap { white-space: normal; }` toggled by token, 2) add aria-label enforcement in lint for header buttons, 3) normalize toast copy via i18n keys: `toast.export.started`, `toast.export.success`, `toast.export.error`. Patch: ``` ``` and in compact: `.label { display:none } .header-btn:focus .label{ display:inline }` but that hides visible label which Samir flagged. Samir (a11y): Hiding the label visually makes the button icon-only for sighted users. For a11y we need the visible label present or a persistent tooltip; otherwise low-vision users lose context. Better to keep label visible but allow wrapping and reduce letter-spacing instead. If space absolutely constrained, show full label on focus and provide tooltip on hover; but ensure focus-visible shows the label (not just tooltip). Nora (Design): Agree. Design compromise: allow label to wrap to two lines and reduce horizontal padding by token.header.compact.horzPadding = 8px but enforce header.minLabelWidth=64px. That preserves legibility. Also copy: prefer noun-first as Alicia suggested. Use microcopy guidance: verbs for CTAs, nouns for toasts. Example: CTA: 'Start export' vs toast: 'Export started'. Evan (Frontend): I'll implement tokens: `token.header.minLabelWidth=64`, `token.header.compact.horzPadding=8`, `token.header.wrapLabels=true`. Update CSS and the toast i18n keys. Will add an ESLint name rule to ensure `aria-label` matches visible label for icon+label buttons. Alicia (Product): Also request: make toast durations configurable and increase export success toast to 3000ms since exports can be background tasks and users may miss the confirmation. Add a small bell animation optional for background actions so users can spot them in peripheral vision without occlusion. Samir (a11y): Bell animation fine if reduced-motion respects prefers-reduced-motion. Also for long-running exports, show a toast with a link to the Activity page (aria-describedby on the link) instead of ephemeral small toast. For failures, we should move focus to a persistent error banner if it's actionable. ops-bot: New PR created: frontend#2678 - "header: compact wrap labels + toast i18n + tokens" Evan (Frontend): I'll add a Cypress test that toggles compact density and asserts label boundingClientRect width >= token.minLabelWidth and that `aria-label` exists for every header button. Tagging @Samir for review. ETA: tomorrow morning. Nora (Design): I'll update Figma tokens and upload a compact header frame showing two-line wrap. Posting shortly in #design-assets. Thanks team. :sparkles:
